verdict.rationale: Motion is a SaaS task and project platform, so a webhook subscription axis applies. The evidence documents only an inbound REST API (X-API-Key auth), a Zapier integration and in-app alerts. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events, and neither Zapier connectivity nor user-facing alerts count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
